programme.title: For the Love of Spock
programme.desc: For the Love of Spock is a heartfelt documentary celebrating the life and legacy of Leonard Nimoy and his iconic portrayal of Spock. Featuring interviews with Zoe Saldaña, Chris Pine, Karl Urban and many more, the film explores how one character became a cultural phenomenon. Directed by Adam Nimoy, Leonard’s son, this intimate tribute blends behind-the-scenes stories, personal memories and fan devotion. A must-watch for Star Trek fans and anyone fascinated by the impact of a true pop culture icon.

programme.title: Mommy Would Never Hurt You
programme.desc: Riley wants nothing more than to rebuild her estranged relationship with her mother and little sister, who are shut-ins due to her sister's illness. But when Riley realizes her sister may not actually be as sick as she appears, Riley's mother catches on, stopping at nothing to keep her daughters with her forever.

programme.title: The Pyscho She Met Online
programme.desc: When Paramedic Karen arrives on the scene of a major car crash, she's stunned that one of the drivers is her husband! For the next few weeks she'll have to take care of him and both will be out of work for some time. They decide to rent two rooms of their house to make ends meet... What they didn't plan on is that one of the first guests is the psychotic Miranda, the sister Karen never knew she had...

programme.title: Showdown in Yesteryear
